svg.aria-label: Octet: HTTP, in binary. An octopus holds the eight bits of 0x35, the length byte of a REQUEST frame.
svg.title: Octet
svg.desc: Deep-sea masthead for Octet, a binary HTTP-like protocol. An octopus grips eight bit cells reading 0 0 1 1 0 1 0 1, which is 0x35, the length byte of the REQUEST frame 00 00 35 01 01 01 shown in the annotated hexdump.

g.text: Six-byte frames instead of CRLF. Ten indexed headers.
One TCP connection, kept open. Two programs,
one spec, and nothing else shared between them.
eight arms, one octet: 0x35 = 53 bytes of REQUEST
